description: List species supported by Ensembl with display name, common name, assembly, taxon ID, and division. Required discovery step — species names like homo_sapiens are opaque to non-biologists and are the input format every other Ensembl tool expects. Use nameContains to find a species by partial name match; filter by division to select one. With no division, lists the endpoint default division — the vertebrates (~356 species on the default GRCh38 endpoint). Species are sorted by internal name and returned max_results at a time (default 50); totalCount reports every match, and when more follow, nextOffset is the offset for the next page.

division.description: Filter to a specific Ensembl division. EnsemblVertebrates includes human, mouse, zebrafish, and other vertebrates. EnsemblPlants covers crop and model plant genomes. EnsemblFungi, EnsemblMetazoa, EnsemblProtists cover non-vertebrate model organisms. Omit to return the endpoint default division (vertebrates).

max_results.description: Maximum number of species to return, counted from offset. Default 50. Set to 0 to return every matching species from offset to the end, uncapped. totalCount always reports the full number of matches before this cap.

nameContains.description: Case-insensitive substring filter applied locally after fetching. Matches against species name, display name, and common name. Example: "sapiens" matches homo_sapiens; "mouse" matches mus_musculus.

offset.description: 0-based position in the name-sorted matches where the returned page starts. Default 0. Pass nextOffset from a previous response to fetch the following page; an offset at or past totalCount returns no species.

name: ensembl_list_species

cap.description: The max_results limit applied to this page.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

nextOffset.description: Offset of the first species after this page — pass it as offset to fetch the next page. Present only when more species follow.

notice.description: Guidance when the filter matches no species, the offset is past the end, or more species follow this page.

shown.description: Number of species returned on this page.

species.description: Species matching the filter criteria, sorted by internal name: at most max_results entries starting at offset.

division.description: Ensembl division this species belongs to (e.g. EnsemblVertebrates, EnsemblPlants).

name.description: Ensembl internal species name in lowercase_underscore format (e.g. homo_sapiens, mus_musculus). This is the value to pass as the species parameter in all other Ensembl tools.

taxonId.description: NCBI taxonomy ID for this species.

totalCount.description: Total number of matching species after local filtering, before offset and max_results. Exceeds the returned species count when the list was paged.

truncated.description: True when more matching species follow this page; request nextOffset to continue.

title: List Ensembl Species
